description: This file defines the ResourceIdentifier class for JSON:API in Drupal, handling resource type, ID, meta information, arity, and comparison/deduplication logic for resource identifiers.

classes.name: ResourceIdentifier
classes.description: Represents a JSON:API resource identifier with type, ID, meta, and arity, including methods for comparison, deduplication, and creation from entities or field items.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a ResourceIdentifier with resource type, ID, and optional meta data.

methods.name: getTypeName
methods.description: Returns the JSON:API resource type name.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Retrieves the ResourceType object, loading it if necessary.

methods.name: hasArity
methods.description: Checks if the resource identifier has an arity value.

methods.name: getArity
methods.description: Returns the arity value; requires hasArity() to be true.

methods.name: withArity
methods.description: Returns a new ResourceIdentifier with the specified arity.

methods.name: isDuplicate
methods.description: Checks if two ResourceIdentifiers are duplicates (same type, ID, and arity).

methods.name: isParallel
methods.description: Checks if two ResourceIdentifiers refer to the same resource regardless of arity.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two ResourceIdentifiers; returns 0 if duplicates, else compares type, ID, and arity.

methods.name: deduplicate
methods.description: Removes duplicate ResourceIdentifiers from an array.

methods.name: areResourceIdentifiersUnique
methods.description: Checks if all ResourceIdentifiers in an array are unique.

methods.name: toResourceIdentifier
methods.description: Creates a ResourceIdentifier from an EntityReferenceItem, with optional arity.

methods.name: toResourceIdentifiers
methods.description: Creates an array of ResourceIdentifiers from entity reference field items.

methods.name: toResourceIdentifiersWithArityRequired
methods.description: Creates an array of ResourceIdentifiers with arity on every value.

methods.name: fromEntity
methods.description: Creates a ResourceIdentifier from an Entity object.

methods.name: getDataReferencePropertyName
methods.description: Helper to find the property name containing the entity in an EntityReferenceItem.

methods.name: getVirtualOrMissingResourceIdentifier
methods.description: Creates a ResourceIdentifier for a null, missing, or dangling entity reference.
